simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to כְּבִיר (H3523) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: כְּבִיר (kᵉbîyr) means a matrass (of intertwined materials) First listed occurrence: 1Sam 19 13.

definitions.full: H3523. kabir [ כָּבִיר ] noun [masculine] probably something netted , i.e. either a quilt or (Ew H. 8. 77 Ke) a fly-net ( κωνωπεῖον ) spread over the face while a person was asleep; 1Sam 19:13 , 16 הָעִזִּים כְּבִיר a quilt (or fly-net ) of goats (' hair). See further Dr on the passage
definitions.rootNote: from 3527 in the original sense of plaiting;
